# Glossary 
<table>
<tr><td width="58%" valign="top">

daisugi is an experimental tree-machine curation repository focused on unconventional forests, probabilistic boosters, interpretable ensembles, and emerging recursive partition systems.

This glossary acts as:

- a machine registry
- a terminology guide
- a reference index
- a research companion

Most engines in daisugi expose a lightweight "(x, y)" interface and follow a consistent verb-oriented workflow.

</td><td width="42%" align="right"><img src="glossary.png" height="420"/></td></tr>
</table>---

## Core Verbs

daisugi standardizes machine workflows through a small set of forestry-inspired verbs.    
     
"`grow_*()`": fit or train a machine       
"`harvest_*()`": generate predictions       
"`trees"`: unified argument for rounds / iterations / estimators    
     
---
## Machine Registry

The following registry links implemented engines to their originating projects, papers, or repositories. Registy also lists the alias in daisugi as well as a set of haikus for TL/DR referencing. 

```{r}
#| include: false
# list source, alias, haikus ------------------

cforest <- c(
  "https://partykit.r-forge.r-project.org/partykit/",
  "conditional",
  "not gain, but a test <br> the split earns its place through chance <br> bias cannot root"
)

evtree <- c(
  "https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/evtree/index.html",
  "evolutionary",
  "natural selection <br> the whole tree evolves at once <br> no greedy shortcuts"
)

ebm <- c(
  "https://interpret.ml/docs/ebm.html",
  "explainable",
  "each feature speaks alone <br> the sum is the whole model <br> darkness becomes light"
)

nrgboost <- c(
  "https://github.com/ajoo/nrgboost",
  "energy",
  "non-discriminative <br> sample all columns with ease <br> no target required"
)

ngboost <- c(
  "https://github.com/stanfordmlgroup/ngboost",
  "natural",
  "not a point, but cloud <br> the natural curve of space <br> to show all outcomes"
)

perpetual <- c(
  "https://perpetual-ml.github.io/perpetual/",
  "perpetual",
  "one knob, the budget <br> self-generalizing design <br> no search, just descent"
)

snap <- c(
  "https://ibmsoe.github.io/snap-ml-doc/v1.6.0/manual.html#snapboost",
  "snap",
  "depth rolls like dice <br> decision or linear <br> random number tricks"
)

wild <- c(
  "https://github.com/pyensemble/wildwood",
  "wild",
  "every pruning weighed <br> out-of-bag shadows voting <br> wildest of all"
)

yggdrasil <- c(
  "https://github.com/google/yggdrasil-decision-forests",
  "yggdrasil",
  "sacred trunk rises <br> c++ decision trees <br> fast quiet giant"
)

# combine -------------------------------------------

df <- rbind(
  cforest = cforest,
  ebm = ebm,
  evtree = evtree,
  nrgboost = nrgboost,
  ngboost = ngboost,
  perpetual = perpetual,
  snapboost = snap,
  wildwood = wild,
  yggdrasil = yggdrasil
)

colnames(df) <- c("docsource", "alias", "haiku")

df <- as.data.frame(df, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```
